strings.error.authorizationRequired: Google needs authorization. Open Settings and click Authorize Google, then open the spreadsheet again.
strings.error.backupQuota: There is no space within the backup limit. The original was preserved and was not sent to Google. Open Backups to delete completed backups or adjust the limit (maximum 1 GB).
strings.error.backupRemoved: This backup has already been marked as cleaned and is not available for restoration or resuming. The Google document and its shortcut were preserved. Use the shortcut to open the online spreadsheet.
strings.error.busy: Another operation is still using the file or registry. Wait and resume; the original and backups were preserved.
strings.error.cancelled: Operation stopped. The backup and recovery record, if created, were preserved.
strings.error.capacity: {reason} The original was preserved. Split the table into smaller files and try again.
strings.error.connectionTimeout: The connection took too long. Check your internet connection and resume through recovery; existing backups were preserved.
strings.error.conversionMismatch: Verification found differences in the converted data. The original and backup were preserved. A copy may exist in Google; check recovery before trying again.
strings.error.copyRequired: This spreadsheet must be imported as a copy; the original must be preserved.
strings.error.csvDelimiter: The CSV may use commas or semicolons. Choose the delimiter in the text options. The original was preserved.
strings.error.exportSize: The export exceeded the verification limit. The original and backup were preserved; check recovery before importing again.
strings.error.formulaVerification: The converted spreadsheet contains formulas the app cannot yet verify. The original and backup were preserved. In Recovery / backups, select this operation and choose Resume as copy to open the spreadsheet in Google without uploading again.
strings.error.generic: Could not complete the operation. Check the settings, connection and whether the file is open in another app. Existing backups remain available.
strings.error.googleAccess: Google denied access. Check authorization and account/folder permissions. The original was preserved.
strings.error.googleConversion: Google rejected the import or the verification export. The original was preserved. Check diagnostics and recovery before trying again.
strings.error.googleUnavailable: Google is temporarily unavailable or has limited requests. The original was preserved. Wait and resume through recovery to avoid uploading again.
strings.error.launcherContext: Use ZagoSheetsWin to open a supported spreadsheet. {reason}
strings.error.localConflict: The file or its association changed. Replacement was stopped to preserve the existing versions.
strings.error.network: Could not communicate with Google. Check the connection and resume through the app; the original was preserved and a pending operation may need recovery.
strings.error.reconciliationRequired: The import is awaiting reconciliation. Do not upload it again manually. Check the recovery guide.
strings.error.setupRequired: Complete first-use setup before opening spreadsheets. Open ZagoSheetsWin or its Settings to connect to Google and save your preferences.
strings.error.textEncoding: Could not read the CSV/TSV encoding. Use UTF-8 or UTF-16 with BOM; for older files, select Windows-1252 in the text options. The original was preserved.
strings.error.textStructure: The CSV/TSV is empty or contains inconsistent rows, delimiters or quotes. Check the delimiter and file structure. The original was preserved.
strings.error.xlsConversion: Could not convert this XLS to XLSX. The original and backup were preserved.
strings.error.xlsxContentType: Could not safely identify the XLSX internal format. The original was preserved. Save a new XLSX copy in Excel or LibreOffice and try that copy.

strings.setup.authorizedReviewSettings: Google connected. Review the options below and save your settings.
strings.setup.connectionExplanation:
Google connection
The app includes the connection configuration. Each person signs in with their own account. A custom JSON is optional. Existing settings are kept.
strings.setup.connectionPrivacy:
Google connection privacy
ZagoSheetsWin uses only the drive.file permission to create and manage files used with the app. Access credentials stay on this computer, protected by Windows, and your spreadsheets are sent directly to Google's APIs - they do not pass through a Zagotools server.
strings.setup.consentRequired: Confirm replacement with backup and, if you use sync, choose a local folder.
strings.setup.defaultsExplanation: Choose ZagoSheetsWin in Windows Default apps. This is optional: you can also use Open with → ZagoSheetsWin.
strings.setup.defaultsHeading: 2. Want to open with a double-click?
strings.setup.description: Open your spreadsheets in Google Sheets with your Google account. The original is backed up before being replaced with a shortcut.
strings.setup.extendedFormats: Enable CSV, TSV, XLS and ODS (experimental).
strings.setup.formatLimits:
Up to 20 MiB per file.
CSV/TSV: 500 thousand cells, 50 thousand rows and one thousand columns.

Content is treated as literal text. If ODS conversion cannot be verified, the original is kept. Your text preferences are preserved.
strings.setup.googleExplanation: Sign in with your own account. Your spreadsheets stay in your Google Drive.
strings.setup.noSync: I do not sync my spreadsheets with Google Drive for Windows, OneDrive or similar apps.
strings.setup.privacyExplanation: Privacy: we use only drive.file for files used with the app. Access credentials stay protected on this computer; spreadsheets go directly to Google, without passing through a Zagotools server.
strings.setup.replaceXls: Replace XLS with a shortcut after verification.
strings.setup.replacementConsent: I understand: after the import is confirmed, the original is replaced with a shortcut; a local backup is saved.
strings.setup.replacementExplanation: After the confirmed import: backup of the original + shortcut to Sheets. Folders are not deleted. In identified synced folders, the original is kept.
strings.setup.savingAuthorizing: Saving and waiting for authorization in your browser…
strings.setup.syncExplanation: Do you use sync? Choose a local folder outside these apps. Removing a file from a synced folder may also delete it from the cloud and other devices.
